plugin.plugin_staffactivity.name: Staff Activity
plugin.plugin_staffactivity.description: Who of the staff is on duty right now: /duty-on, /duty-idle and /duty-off, shown on a live status board (green, yellow, red) by team.
plugin.plugin_staffactivity.setting.chan: The bot keeps one status board here and edits it on every change.
plugin.plugin_staffactivity.setting.team: E.g. Support and Admins, each with its role. Only members with a team role can set a duty status. No teams: everyone can, shown as one list.
plugin.plugin_staffactivity.setting.show: Show members who are off duty
Off: the board lists only who is on duty or idle.
plugin.plugin_staffactivity.setting.auto: A status older than this turns off by itself (forgotten /duty-off). 0 = never.
plugin.plugin_staffactivity.node.set_sta: Sets the member on duty, idle or off duty and updates the board.
